_readme: Rate cards for the Alpha Shadow Service, with provenance and validity
windows. Rates are USD per MILLION tokens unless the field says otherwise.
A null rate means UNKNOWN, not free: the service REFUSES to call a model
it cannot price, because an unpriced call is costed at zero and would
effective_until is a HARD boundary. Once it passes, the card stops
applying and the model becomes unpriced until a successor entry is added.
That is deliberate: a rate whose window has closed is not the current
rate, and quietly pricing today at last year's numbers is exactly the
error this field exists to prevent.
These figures were supplied by the operator on 2026-09-09 and are NOT
verified by this repository. Check them against each vendor's current
pricing page before relying on any cost-adjusted conclusion.

entries.notes: short-context tier; xAI also returns usage.cost_in_usd_ticks, which is reconciled against this card when present
output rate covers thinking tokens. The window CLOSES on 2026-12-31: add the successor card rather than letting this one price 2027.
escalation to a stronger model is a config change; add its card here first or it will be refused as unpriced

entries.source: in-process; genuinely zero, which is a different statement from unknown
entries.notes: no vendor call is made for this provider
